request_policy.redirect_limitation: Five initial requested URLs auto-followed redirects (Docker blog feed, three Elastic lab sitemaps, www.Discord sitemap); intermediate-hop timing was not logged and is not claimed to meet the per-host pacing bound. Later helper disables automatic redirects. Requested URL starts were paced per host.

publishers.scope: All product-section editorial archives declared by JetBrains root sitemap; only successfully accessible child maps and feed retained. Date-path metadata was parsed for YYYY/MM/DD and YYYY/MM paths; day unknown on month-only paths.

endpoints.terminal: finite feed consumed; no historical completeness inferred from feed length

terminal.qualification: A sitemap proves exhaustion of publisher-declared discoverability, not every article ever published or article body reading.
